record.field: CRM & Sales Automation System

A custom CRM and sales automation platform for TechVision Corporation to manage their B2B sales pipeline across 3 regional offices and a 45-person sales team. The system replaces a mix of spreadsheets and a legacy on-premise CRM that lacks automation capabilities.

Key deliverables:

  • Lead capture and qualification module
  • Visual sales pipeline with Kanban board
  • Automated follow-up email sequences (drip campaigns)
  • Sales forecasting with probability weighting
  • Gmail and Outlook email client integration (two-way sync)
  • Management reporting dashboard with KPI charts

Lead Management Module (Create, Qualify, Assign)
story
done

Build the lead management core: create leads manually with fields (company, contact, source, budget, requirement notes), lead qualification scoring, and assignment to sales rep with notification email.

Lead creation form validates all required fields. Assignment notification email sent within 30s. Lead score calculated automatically based on budget, company size, and source. Duplicate lead detection alerts are shown.
Contact Database Schema & API
task
done

Design and implement the contact database schema supporting: individuals linked to companies, multiple phone numbers, social media profiles, custom fields, and contact tagging. Build CRUD API with search by name/company/email.
Contacts support many-to-one company relationship. Custom fields are configurable by admin without code change. Full-text search covers name, email, and company fields.
Customer Profile 360° View
story
done

Build the customer 360° profile page consolidating: company info, all contacts, interaction timeline (calls, emails, meetings), open leads and deals, and total revenue to date. Sidebar shows key account stats at a glance.
Profile page loads within 1 second. Timeline shows most recent 50 interactions. Revenue figure aggregated from closed-won deals. Page is accessible on tablet (1024px).
Basic Sales Reporting Dashboard
improvement
done

Build a management dashboard with: new leads this month (vs last month), lead conversion rate, pipeline value by stage, top 5 sales reps by closed revenue, and a monthly trend chart (bar chart). Date range filter for all widgets.
Dashboard widgets refresh every 5 minutes. Date range filter applies to all widgets simultaneously. Charts rendered using Chart.js. Data export to Excel available per widget.
Data Import Tool (Excel / CSV → Leads & Contacts)
task
done

Build an Excel/CSV import tool with column mapping UI, data validation, duplicate detection, and error reporting. Support importing 10,000+ rows asynchronously with a progress indicator and email notification on completion.
Supports .xlsx and .csv up to 10MB. Duplicate detection based on email address. Rows with errors skipped and reported in downloadable error file. Import runs as background job — does not block UI.
Sales Pipeline Kanban Board (Drag & Drop)
story
done

Build the sales pipeline Kanban board: drag-and-drop deals between stages, deal cards showing company name, value, assigned rep, and expected close date. Column headers display total pipeline value. Stage configuration managed by admin.
Drag-and-drop updates deal stage immediately via API. Pipeline total updates on drag. Stage columns are scrollable horizontally. Works on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari.
Deal Stage & Win/Loss Management
story
done

Implement deal lifecycle management: create deal with value, probability, and expected close date; mark as Closed-Won or Closed-Lost with mandatory reason selection; deal history log of all stage changes with timestamps.
Won/Lost reasons are configurable by admin. Deal history log is immutable (read-only). Won deals are excluded from active pipeline totals. Lost reason analytics available in dashboard.
Activity Log & Notes Module (Calls, Emails, Meetings)
task
done

Build the activity timeline for leads and deals: log phone calls (duration, outcome, notes), emails (subject, recipient, summary), meetings (date, attendees, outcome), and manual notes. All activities are visible in the 360° customer profile.
Activity types are extensible. Upcoming scheduled activities trigger reminder notifications. Activity timeline sorted by date descending. Overdue activities highlighted in red.
Advanced Lead & Deal Search with Saved Filters
improvement
done

Build an advanced search filter panel with multi-field filtering (assigned rep, stage, date range, deal value range, tags) and the ability to save and name filter presets per user. Share filter presets across teams.
Filter presets save and reload correctly. Filters can be combined (AND logic). Saved filters visible in "My Filters" dropdown. Shared filters visible to all team members.
Automated Follow-Up Email Sequences (Drip Campaigns)
story
in_progress

Build a drip campaign engine: define email sequences with configurable delays (send after X days if no reply), personalization tokens, stop conditions (on reply, on meeting booked, on deal won/lost), and open/click tracking.

Sequences support up to 10 steps. Emails personalized with contact first name, company, and assigned rep. Sequence stops automatically on reply. Open and click rates tracked per step. Unsubscribe link mandatory in all emails.
Sales Forecasting Module with Probability Weighting
story
in_progress

Build the sales forecast view: each pipeline stage has a configurable win probability percentage. Forecast shows weighted pipeline value (deal value × stage probability) by month. Compare forecast vs actual closed revenue on a line chart.
Forecast recalculates within 2 seconds when a deal is moved. Monthly and quarterly views available. Manager can override individual deal probability. Forecast data exportable to Excel.

OAuth connection flow completes in under 30 seconds. Emails from last 30 days auto-imported on first connect. New emails sync within 5 minutes. Disconnect option available in settings.

story

Dashboard restricted to manager role. Leaderboard sortable by any KPI column. Period selector: this week, this month, this quarter, custom range. All charts printable to PDF.

CSV lead import silently fails for company names containing special characters
confirmed
major
Staging — Python 3.11, openpyxl 3.1.2, CSV with UTF-8 encoding

When importing a CSV file containing company names with special characters such as ampersands (&), quotes, or parentheses, those specific rows are silently skipped. No error is reported for the skipped rows in the import error report.

1. Create a CSV with a company name containing "&" (e.g., "Smith & Jones Ltd"). 2. Upload via Import Tool → Leads. 3. Map columns and start import. 4. Row with special character company name is skipped but not listed in the error report. 5. Check database — that lead was not created.
All rows should be imported correctly regardless of special characters in company names. Rows that fail validation should appear in the downloadable error report with a clear reason.

Rows with special characters in the company name field are silently skipped. Root cause: the CSV parser uses the company name as a unique key without escaping — the SQL INSERT fails silently due to unescaped characters in the parameterized query.
Lead assignment email notification not sent to newly assigned sales rep
in_progress
critical
Staging and Production — SendGrid API v3, Python Celery task queue

When a lead is assigned (or reassigned) to a sales rep via the CRM interface or the API, the expected email notification is not delivered to the assigned user. The Celery task log shows the task was queued but the SendGrid API returns a 400 error on delivery attempts.

1. Log in as manager. Go to Leads list. 2. Open any lead and change the Assigned Rep dropdown to a different user. 3. Save the lead. 4. Check the newly assigned sales rep's email — no notification received. 5. Check Celery task log — task queued but SendGrid API returns 400 Bad Request.
Assigned sales rep receives an email within 30 seconds of assignment with the lead's company name, contact, and a direct link to the lead in CRM.

No email is sent. Celery task shows SendGrid 400 error: "The from address does not match a verified Sender Identity." The notification email uses a dynamic from address that is not verified in the SendGrid account.
Sales dashboard chart displays incorrect total revenue for Q1 2026
new
minor
Staging — Dashboard, Q1 2026 date range filter

When the sales dashboard date range is set to Q1 2026 (Jan 1 – Mar 31), the "Total Closed Revenue" widget shows a figure that is approximately 12% lower than the actual sum of closed-won deals from the same period in the deals list view.

1. Go to Sales Dashboard. 2. Set date range filter to Q1 2026 (Jan 1 – Mar 31, 2026). 3. Note the "Total Closed Revenue" figure (e.g., VND 2.15 billion). 4. Go to Deals → filter by Closed-Won, same date range. 5. Manually sum the deal values — result is VND 2.44 billion. 6. Discrepancy: the dashboard shows ~12% less than the actual total.
The "Total Closed Revenue" dashboard widget should match the exact sum of all Closed-Won deal values for the selected date range.
Dashboard total is ~12% lower than actual. Suspected cause: the dashboard SQL query uses deal close date from the deal creation timestamp rather than the date the deal was marked as Closed-Won.
